title: Pokémon TCG Black Friday deals 2026 UK: what gets cheaper and what to buy at RRP
description: Pokémon TCG Black Friday 2026: Delta Reign and 30th Celebration prices checked today, UK RRPs, stock limits and which products actually drop.
intro:
**Don't expect big Pokémon TCG discounts this Black Friday: new sets like Delta Reign and 30th Celebration rarely drop below RRP, so paying £49.99 for an Elite Trainer Box is a good result.** Smyths has both ETBs listed at £49.99, and Amazon has been selling them for £44.99 through invite-only listings.

What does get cheaper on Black Friday is older stock: tins, collection boxes, Battle Academy and blister packs from previous sets. Black Friday 2026 is on 27 November. Prices checked on retailers' own pages on 13 November 2026.

body:
## Will Pokémon cards be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Mostly no, at least not for new sets. Here's what happened last year: Amazon sold the Phantasmal Flames and Mega Evolution Elite Trainer Boxes at their normal price, often by invitation only. The real Black Friday 2025 cuts were on older or bundled products, such as Battle Academy at £16.99 (down from £24.99) and blister packs. Smyths cut its 2025 Holiday Calendar from £49.99 to £20, but only after the December rush.

As of 13 November, no big UK retailer has announced Pokémon TCG Black Friday offers. Smyths' early Black Friday picks include a Pikachu toy but no trading cards. Expect the same pattern in 2026: discounts on tins, collection boxes and older sets, and RRP at best on Delta Reign and 30th Celebration.

## The current sets and their UK RRPs

The Mega Evolution era is running, and the three newest sets are:

- **Pitch Black** (July 2026): mostly sold out at Argos and Smyths now.
- **30th Celebration** (September 2026): the anniversary set, so demand is high.
- **Delta Reign** (6 November 2026): the newest set. The Build & Battle Box goes on general sale on 20 November.

UK RRPs for Delta Reign, which are typical for a main set:

- **Elite Trainer Box:** £49.99 (the Pokémon Center exclusive is £56.99 with 11 packs).
- **Booster Bundle:** £24.99.
- **Three-pack blister:** £13.99.
- **Single booster pack:** £4.29.
- **36-pack booster box:** about £154.44.

Anything at or below these is a fair price. Independent shops are currently charging £62 to £70 for Delta Reign ETBs, and resale listings go much higher, so don't pay over RRP for a box you'll open.

## Amazon's invite-only prices

Amazon UK lists several new products below RRP, but you have to request an invitation and wait to be picked. Prices reported on 12 November included the Delta Reign and 30th Celebration ETBs at £44.99, the Delta Reign Booster Bundle at £23.94 and an 18-pack Delta Reign display at £71.82. Request an invitation on any product you'd like: it costs nothing, and you're not charged unless you're chosen. Many Amazon Black Friday prices need [Prime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime), so see our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) if you're not a member.

## How to get Pokémon cards at RRP

- **Check Smyths, Argos and Amazon first.** They sell at RRP and limit quantities, which keeps scalpers out. Smyths allows one ETB or Booster Bundle per customer.
- **Look at Hamleys too.** It stocks Pokémon TCG; see our [Hamleys Black Friday guide](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/) for its sale dates.
- **Use the free Groudon promo.** Spend £29.99 or more on Pokémon TCG at Smyths, GAME, HMV, The Entertainer and other shops until 31 December, while stocks last, and you get a promo card. Argos, Amazon and the Pokémon Center are excluded.
- **Skip third-party marketplace sellers** listing new sets at double the price. Restocks come every few weeks.

For more on ETBs, see our [Pokémon Elite Trainer Box deals guide](/guides/pokemon-elite-trainer-box-deals-uk/). For other present ideas, see our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## What's coming next?

Argos has 30th Celebration mini tins listed at £13 each as "coming soon". In the US, 30th Celebration ex Tins and the Unova Heavy Hitters Premium Collection arrive on 4 December, then a Valentine's box in January and the next main set, expected to be Flowing Fists, in February 2027. UK dates usually match or follow closely.

## Pokémon TCG Black Friday FAQs

### Does Pokémon TCG go on sale for Black Friday?

Older products do: tins, collection boxes, Battle Academy and blister packs from past sets. New sets such as Delta Reign usually stay at RRP, so buying them at RRP is the realistic target.

### What's a good price for an Elite Trainer Box in 2026?

£49.99 is the UK RRP for a standard ETB, and Amazon's invite-only price of £44.99 is the lowest reported price for the newest sets. Avoid paying £60 or more unless the set is long sold out.

### Is there a Pokémon TCG advent calendar for 2026?

None had been announced by 10 November. Earlier calendars launched in late summer. John Lewis's listing is no longer available online, and the 2025 edition is out of stock at most shops.

### Where can I buy Pokémon cards at RRP in the UK?

Smyths, Argos, Amazon (often by invitation), Hamleys, GAME and the Pokémon Center UK all sell at or near RRP. Specialist shops like Zatu and Magic Madhouse sometimes charge RRP but sell out quickly.

### Are Pokémon cards a good Christmas present?

Yes, for a fan. A booster bundle or a small collection box under £25 is a safe pick. Leave very expensive boxes to collectors who've asked for them.
